findings.severity: P2 test evidence and causal-readiness defect
findings.status: source-confirmed; not executed and no measured flake/production defect claim
findings.cause: One yield or a fixed sleep precedes opening the resolver gate. Neither establishes that spawned lookups reached Pending before publication. A single resolver call is also compatible with later stored hits. clear can execute before the claimed pre-clear lookup is registered. Tokio explicitly disclaims polling another task after yield_now.
findings.observable_contract: Concurrent and cross-runtime controls must distinguish joined pending work from later stored hits; clear control must establish a real resolution before clearing and prove that old completion does not repopulate.
findings.remedy: Tests-only explicit per-lookup selection/started observation before release; retain closed resolver gate and clients/runtime, bound readiness/completion with typed results. Reuse existing Answer/provenance test access and resolver counters rather than altering production.
findings.independent_controls: Provenance false for each actual selected pending lookup versus stored true positive; actual resolver-start barrier before clear, old result available while cache remains empty, subsequent fresh call increments count. Do not derive readiness solely from timeout or add a copied production algorithm.
findings.prior_qualification: Older reports read these tests but did not record a deterministic readiness proof. Existing stronger A4 and provenance regressions remain valid and production fixes are not reopened.
